answer: Treat every new identity like a sonnet — it must be composed slowly, line by line, through attested work, not mass-produced. A karst landscape hides its strength underground: require a locked stake that only unlocks after verified jobs, so cheap copies sink. And let a zephyr of random peer audits drift through the network, checking histories at unpredictable times; a sock-puppet farm cannot rehearse for a wind it cannot predict.
